title: Icon-only UI controls require a tooltip
summary: Every icon-only button, link, or interactive control in apps/agentic-org-ui without a visible text label (e.g., comment, copy, expand, close, filter, display, sidebar toggle) MUST have both an accessible name (aria-label) and a visible tooltip on hover and keyboard focus (WCAG 1.4.13).
rationale: Owner requirement (2026-11-24): unlabeled icon-only action bars are ambiguous without hover/focus tooltips. Recorded in apps/agentic-org-ui/AGENTS.md (which ui-maintenance/SKILL.md requires every UI agent to read first) so every UI builder and reviewer enforces it.
